biotools.summary: DMRichR is an R package designed for analyzing differentially methylated regions (DMRs) in epigenetic research, particularly useful for non-model organisms. It leverages existing algorithms (dmrseq, bsseq) and provides tools for data processing, annotation, and visualization.
